messages:
incident-bot: [SEV 2] LatencyStorm alert for dedicated pool dp-42 — p99 requests hitting ~12s, p95 ~3s. Streaming sessions showing stalls and reconnects. Autoscaler attempted scale but nodes not healthy. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ops/dp-42 :rotating_light:

ashley (oncall): paging triage. I'm on call. seeing queue depth spike to ~900 and backlog growth on the tail router. streaming tail p99 > 10s. marking customer-impacting. @customer-success FYI.

kai: ack. checking autoscaler logs + node bootstrap. initial read: new GPU nodes never finished model priming (kv-cache priming timeout). likely coldstart + burst.

deploy-bot: autoscaler triggered scale-up at 3399998890 -> requested +4 nodes, status: PROVISIONING, handshake_timeouts: 2, health_checks_failed: 1

ashley (oncall): attempts to let autoscaler finish causing more queue buildup — need immediate mitigations: 1) force-add warm nodes 2) deprioritize best-effort customers 3) route streaming to fallback region/model.

kai: running manual scale and warmup now. command: ```bash
# force add 4 warm nodes and prefill model cache
redwoodctl pool scale --pool dp-42 --add 4 --force
redwoodctl pool prewarm --pool dp-42 --model redwood-large-v1 --timeout 300
```

nate: preparing fallback routing rule to divert non-critical streaming to smaller quant model to keep latency stable. rule: route where tier=="best-effort" -> model: redwood-small-quant. Applying now.

maria: CS update sent to affected accounts (acct-1024, acct-2048). brief: "We're investigating elevated latency for streaming ondedicated capacity; temporary mitigations in flight. We'll provide updates every 30m." Escalation contacts included.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed: increase ephemeral burst cap, enable prewarm flag for pool dp-42, create temporary queue-priority rule. Logged runbook ID rb-2026-07-3399.

ashley (oncall): manual prewarm completed for 2 nodes, 2 still pending. observed immediate p95 drop from 3s -> ~1.1s for routed traffic to warmed nodes. tail still noisy.

kai: found root cause for priming timeouts: bootstrap image was failing on /opt/model/weights mount on new hosts (race during image overlay). adding a short sleep to init script and re-deploying image. patch: ```diff
- start-model
+ sleep 5 && start-model
```

deploy-bot: new bootstrap image pushed to dp-42 pool at 3399998915, rolling restart of provisioning VMs started.

nate: fallback routing in effect — best-effort streaming now on quant model. that reduced p99 for critical customers by ~60%. Metrics: critical-p99 from 12s -> 2.6s.

maria: CS pushed follow-up message to impacted accounts with ETA for full mitigation ~20-30m. customers asking about request/ingestion retries -> advised not to retry aggressively.

ashley (oncall): temporary throttles applied to non-prod and low-tier plans: token_rate_limit reduced by 60% for 15m-window. keeps main lane healthy.

kai: patch verified on new nodes, remaining provisioning completed. pool capacity +4 now healthy. KV cache priming success checks passing. tail p99 improving but still bouncing on some long sessions (stalls).

ashley (oncall): summary of live mitigations performed: - forced scale +4 and prewarm - applied quant-model fallback for best-effort - throttled low-tier traffic - patched bootstrap image to address priming race - CS notified + ongoing updates

ashley (oncall): leaving live handoff to kai at 04:00 UTC — will monitor for 15m then handoff. notes in pager: reuse fallback route if p99 > 4s; escalation to SRE lead if queue depth > 600 after mitigations.

kai: taking over. will keep the routed fallback and throttle in place for now and watch streaming tail. starting deeper trace on tail requests to identify any repeated key patterns. tagging heap/profile capture on 3 nodes.

customer-success: confirmed customers saw reduced error/reconnect rate. CS to follow up with one-on-one for the largest impacted tenant.

ashley (oncall): thanks team. will close the paging after 2 clean 5-min windows for p99 < 4s. current status: p99 ~2.8s, p95 ~1.0s, queue depth ~220 and falling. :white_check_mark:

kai: leaving a TODO: create post-incident ticket to add prewarm health check in autoscaler and add a bootstrap validation to CI to catch image overlay races. assigning to eng-runtime.

ashley (oncall): handing off officially — kai is on until 06:00 UTC. I'll update incident doc and mark as active with mitigations.

incident-bot: incident log appended to https://incidents.redwood/3399998888. paging cleared at 3399998950 (monitoring continue).
